int.text: Hit RX 4
We lost Delta Three!
Silverbolt!  Do we even HAVE a plan?
No kidding! I can already feel it searing my circuits!
Wow! Is that the relay station?
Now you're talking, Silverbolt!
Heads up! Decepticon Brutes!
In your FACE, Megatron.
Watch out! Decepticons incoming!
110%...? It goes that high?
YES! The beam is down!
What the--? What just happened?
Well GREAT. What do we do NOW?
Now you're talking, Silverbolt!

fra.text: On aurait dû commencer par là !

int.text: Was that -- did that thing just talk?
And HOW, exactly, are we supposed to disable this thing?

fra.text: C'est bien joli, mais comment tu comptes t'y prendre, au juste ?

int.text: That sounded like laughter. Was that laughter??
Destroy the turrets!
What's he changing into? ...Are those TEETH?
Wooohoo!
Watch those missiles!
Terrific -- here comes the welcoming committee.
Yaaahhh!
So how do we do that?
Silverbolt, I gotta say I wasn't thrilled when Optimus named you leader of the squad instead of me.
No, no--  hear me out!  What I MEAN to say is--you don't entirely suck at the job.  You know, for a guy who's afraid of heights and all.

fra.text: Non, non... laisse-moi finir ! Ce que je veux dire, c'est que tu t'en sors plutôt bien, finalement ! Enfin, je veux dire, pour un type qui a peur du vide, en tout cas.

int.text: It's a compliment!
What--? It's a dead end!
Yeah! How you like THAT, Decepti-Creeps!

fra.text: Ouais ! Qu'est-ce que vous dites de ça, Decepticons !

int.text: I never do!
Now THAT'S what I'm talking about!
No need to rush on my account -- I like blasting Decepticons!
Wait a second! Trypticon's a Cybertronian right?
Then he must have a conversion cog.  If we destroy it, he won't be able to stay online as a gun.  He'll revert to his original form.
They're gonna kill Prime!  Move!  Move!  Move!
That's good right?  This is good?

fra.text: Ça veut dire qu'on a réussi, c'est ça ?

int.text: So what exactly are the odds of us making it out of this?
What the--?
Fine, how do we get past it?

fra.text: Parfait. Et comment on la franchit ?

int.text: That seemed pretty easy
What is that thing?
What's it gonna take with this guy?

fra.text: Ce monstre est invincible, ou quoi ?

int.text: There!  That will do it!
Heads up!  Decepticons!
Arrrggggh!
Pull up!
Look at this...bodies everywhere!
ARRRRGGGGHHH!
INTRUDERS! Decepticons -- melt them down!
Access hatch - opened.
Alert! Coolant levels, lowering.
Red Alert. Structural integrity at 95%. Replace coolant immediately.

fra.text: Alerte ! Intégrité structurelle à 95%. Relancez le système de refroidissement !

int.text: Red Alert. Structural integrity at 90%.
Alert! Energon Beam integrity is compromised.

fra.text: Alerte ! Intégrité du faisceau d'énergon compromise !

int.text: Red Alert. Structural integrity at 85%.
Red Alert. Structural integrity at 80%
Danger. Plasma rising to critical level.

fra.text: Danger ! Agitation du plasma en hausse !

int.text: Danger. Plasma approaching critical level.

fra.text: Danger ! Agitation proche du seuil critique.

int.text: Danger! Plasma level at 90%!
Danger! Plasma level at 100%
Danger! Plasma level at 110%
Intruder alert!
Yellow Alert!  Coolant Pump Deactivated.  Beam subject to overheating.

fra.text: Alerte ! Pompe de refroidissement désactivée ! Risque de surchauffe du rayon !

int.text: Got another transport out of control!

fra.text: On a encore un transport en perdition !

int.text: Watch it! Get too close to that beam and you're either fried by radiation, or zapped by a plasma flare.
Yes. It splits the beam to redistribute power. I never thought I'd have to see it again.
There! Disable the safety locks.
The beam that powers the gun runs so hot, this entire area is dedicated to cooling it. If we can disrupt the cooling process, the gun won't be able to fire.
There -- activate that terminal. We need to pinpoint the location of the coolant pump so we can shut it down.
The main controls are below the surface of the coolant.  Quickly get into the sub-coolant pod .
Okay -- we still have to flush the tanks! Head to the coolant control room!
This is it -- the coolant control room!  You've got the controls straight ahead!
Long story. MEGATRON! Enough lives have been lost! You've got to stop this madness!
I wear the Autobot insignia with pride, Megatron.
Quickly! Drain the coolant!
Every nanoklik counts -- but we can accelerate the process by overloading the pulse regulator from the station's nerve center. That would definitely finish it off.
The nerve center is just ahead!

fra.text: Le centre d'opérations est droit devant !

int.text: We need to overload the beam's pulse regulator. Hit those switches on the far panel.
Now, throw that second switch.
Hold them off! We have to give the plasma time to overload!
No, that's the point! It's about to blow!
There's got to be some kind of weak point! Just keep flying!
Oh, great Primus. I think this gun is a Cybertronian!
This looks like the vapor quantex chambers! Keep going!
There! Blast it!
That'll give the transports enough time to escape.
Wait for it to charge up, then blast it!
It's gonna be pretty choppy in those vents!

fra.text: Ça risque de pas mal secouer dans ces conduits !

int.text: Blast that vent door open!
All right, guys, the coolant pump is just ahead!
Not fast enough, it isn't.  When we get to the nerve center we can REALLY cause some damage!
Look at that! The beam is just...eating those guys!
Come on, come on!  Overload already!
The station's about to detonate! We've got to get out of the blast range!

fra.text: La station va exploser ! On doit absolument s'éloigner le plus possible !

int.text: Aim for the fuel cells on the back of the Destroyer!
Yeah? So?
We don't even know what his original form is!
Watch out!  Cloakers!
From here we can find the main control room, and flush the rest of the coolant out of the station.

fra.text: D'ici, on peut trouver la salle de contrôle et vidanger le reste du liquide de refroidissement de la station.

int.text: Were almost there guys.  The nerve center is just up ahead.
The gun is just behind that barricade
Be careful of the automated defenses!
Blast the weapons systems!
Its charging again--shoot it!

fra.text: Il se recharge encore ! Feu à volonté !

int.text: Silverbolt!  He's jetting straight for the planet!
Blast the pulse regulator!
Yes, sir!
Jetfire, after all this time--you've come home!
You should've joined my Decepticons when you had the chance, Jetfire.
There is no pride to be had in humiliation and death. Decepticons! Attack!
Your cause is lost, Autobots!
I grow tired of this display. Finish them! Then bring me their heads!
I must say, Autobots, your stupidity is staggering. Did you not account for backup systems at all? No? Pity. Decepticons, find the Autobot intruders and dispose of them immediately.
Trypticon -- the Autobots are keeping the rest of their transports grounded. Take aim at the planet's surface -- destroy Iacon City!
Trypticon! I have the coordinates for Optimus Prime's exact location!  Target him now!
Silverbolt! We're taking a pounding down here! Get that gun offline!
We're tracking the descent, Silverbolt. We'll take it from here!
Fly through the debris, Autobots! And don't get too close to that beam!
Hold steady! Focus on the ones we can still save!
The Energon Bridge draws power directly from Cybertron to fuel the gun. We'll follow the beam up to the station and shut it off!
Nice flying, Autobots!
Kick in those afterburners, Autobots! Every second counts!
Stand back!
The crash exposed some exhaust tubes up ahead.  Looks like we found our entrance!
This must be the coolant room.

fra.text: Ça doit être la salle de refroidissement.

int.text: That got their attention! Decepticons incoming!
Let's move, Autobots!
Nice job! Keep moving!
Jetfire -- how does he know you?
Never! We'll fight to our last spark!
Now THAT'S how you finish a fight.

fra.text: Je trouve qu'on a été MAGNIFIQUE !

int.text: Jetfire! How long before it hits critical?
Well then lead the way!

fra.text: Alors passe devant. On te suit !

int.text: Another transport's been hit! We've got to hurry! C'mon, Autobots -- we're not just doing this for Optimus. We're doing this for CYBERTRON!
Alright, we're here. What now, Jetfire?
Head through that exhaust vent! C'mon, MOVE!
We kill it at the source! Autobots, full thrusters! We need to find a way into that gun -- we'll blow it up from the inside!
Yeah, it did -- and it's about to fire on Iacon!
Autobots -- there, at the energy conduit! That's our point of entry! Go! Now! MOVE!
We're inside the gun now, Optimus! We'll disable it ASAP!
C'mon, guys, hurry! Every time that gun fires, more Autobots die!
Look out! Don't let those mashers catch you!
Did you hear that? One direct hit and Optimus is scrapped! HURRY!
Come on! Blast it!
We need to get out of here NOW!

fra.text: On doit sortir d'ici, et TOUT DE SUITE !

int.text: We made it! Now -- let's finish this guy off!
Keep firing!
Autobots -- VEER OFF! Let gravity do the rest!
Optimus! Trypticon is falling out of orbit!
Keep moving! Head through the Beam Conduit.

fra.text: Continuez ! Remontez la conduite du faisceau !

int.text: Its not over yet--watch out for that central laser!
That's our ticket inside the station!  Shoot your way in!

fra.text: C'est notre porte d'entrée dans la station ! Forcez le passage !

int.text: Destroy  the control node!
Well--I say we start blasting stuff.
Very funny, Air Raid.
Let's take it down!
Great job, guys!
Jetfire, you were dead on! The station's coming apart at the seams!

fra.text: Jetfire, tu es un génie ! Cette station commence déjà à partir en morceaux !

int.text: No such thing, jump down through the coolant.
Burn through 'em, Autobots! Don't even slow down!
Every nanoklik longer means more Autobot deaths. Hold your ground! Here comes another wave!
Go! Go! Go!
Maybe not, but anything is better than this! Great idea, Air Raid!
-groan- Typical. DECEPTICONS INBOUND!
Turrets! Autobots -- find cover!
Really, Air Raid? You pick NOW to talk about this?
Focus Air Raid, Optimus is counting on us. No matter what we will see this through .
There are the controls.
It's opening. Let's Move
Watch out for those rockets!
Aim at his jet packs!  We're not finished with him yet!

fra.text: Visez ses propulseurs ! On n'en a pas encore fini avec lui !

int.text: Nice shot!
He's falling out of control now!  Pour it on!
Incompetent fools.  Find the Autobots immediately!
The Autobots have overloaded the entire cooling system! Megatron will vaporize us if Trypticon goes offline. MOVE!

fra.text: Ils ont saboté le système de refroidissement ! Megatron va tous nous massacrer si Trypticon tombe en panne ! BOUGEZ-VOUS !

int.text: As you command, Lord Megatron. Readjusting alignment. Initiating bombardment of Iacon.

fra.text: À tes ordres, seigneur Megatron. Ajustement de la trajectoire. Initialisation du bombardement.

int.text: Hahahaha!
You cannot stop me, little Autobots. I am...Trypticon. I am...your death.
I live to serve Megatron...and to destroy Autobots!
Yes, Lord Megatron! Zeroing in on coordinates now!
Lord Megatron -- Optimus Prime's location is now target-locked. Powering up for maximum impact.
Discharge power at 75%. Soon Optimus Prime will cease to exist.
No! NO! Cannot maintain cannon form!

fra.text: Non ! NON ! Changement de forme initialisé !

int.text: You will pay DEARLY for this, Autobots!
Rooooooaaaaaar!
Pathetic!
I will grind you into dust for this, Autobots!
Destruction of Iacon City at 5% completion. Hall of Ancients defenses nearing failure.
Calculating angle for maximum damage to Code Archives.
Re-acquiring target alignment parameters for Stellar Galleries.
Direct hit to Zeta Prime's Vault. Destruction of Iacon City at 9.48% completion.
You will SUFFER for this, Autobots!
RRROOOAAAARRR!!!!
Insolent little trash-heaps! You will never destroy me.
Ha!  Ha!  Ha!  You haven't defeated me, Autobots!  You have only untethered your own destroyer!
Feel the burn of my laser!
Your cause is hopeless!  You cannot hope to defeat TRYPTICON!
You haven't seen the last of TRYPTICON!
Roar 1
Roar 3
Roar 4
Roar 5
Roar 6
Enter freely, Autobots. All you shall find is your destruction.
